build_dataset_state: build a DatasetState to get config names, config states, and artifact states for a dataset
build_cache_state: build a CacheState to check if a cache entry exists, is successful, or needs retry
build_job_state: build a JobState to check if a job is in process for a given dataset revision
build_split_state: build a SplitState to get artifact states for all processing steps of a dataset split
build_first_steps_dataset_state: build a FirstStepsDatasetState to get only the first processing step artifact states for a dataset
